citation.authors: R. S. Ehrmann, K. M. Loftin, S. Johnson, and E. B. White
citation.title: Lock-in of elastically mounted airfoils at a 90 degree angle of attack

digitization.method: Publisher JPEG markers thresholded at 30 percent grayscale, connected components classified by marker shape, and axes converted with the recorded linear or logarithmic pixel calibration.
digitization.uncertainty_policy: The CSV uncertainty columns are graphical extraction allowances based on about two source pixels and are not experimental uncertainty bars.

figure_6.condition_boundary: The publisher raster identifies the airfoil and plotted variables but does not visibly identify a unique mass-damping value. It is used as the reported representative NACA 0018 response sweep, not silently assigned to either simulated endpoint.

figure_7.condition_boundary: These points support a peak-amplitude versus mass-damping comparison. Interpolation is allowed only inside the digitized marker range; the simulated lower endpoint at 0.96 is reported against the nearest digitized boundary point without extrapolation.
